title: Jobs Aggregator Scraper Input
description: Search public no-key job APIs and export clean, deduplicated remote job listings.

source.title: Source
source.description: Choose one job API source or search all supported sources.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Job title, skill, or company keywords. Records must match at least one keyword.

location.title: Location Contains
location.description: Optional text filter for job location, such as Worldwide, Europe, Germany, London, or Remote.

remoteOnly.title: Remote Only
remoteOnly.description: Only keep jobs that are remote or from remote-first sources.

dateFrom.title: Posted From
dateFrom.description: Optional ISO date filter. Jobs without a parseable posted date are excluded when this is set.

maxResults.title: Max Results
maxResults.description: Maximum clean job records to save.

maxPagesPerSource.title: Max Pages Per Source
maxPagesPerSource.description: Pagination limit for sources that expose pages. Remote OK and Remotive are single-response APIs.

includeDescription.title: Include Description
includeDescription.description: Include cleaned job description text in the dataset. This makes records larger.
